name: Create or Destroy Water
summary: Creates up to 10 gallons of clean water or destroys water and fog in an area.

m.text: a mix of water and sand

stats.effect:
You do one of the following:

***Create Water.*** You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/cube} within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.

***Destroy Water.*** You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
stats.higherLevels: You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the {ref:glossary/cube} increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
